source.english_context: Unit 02 Documents and Official Rules Goal: protect important papers and understand when official information matters. Daily Life English Is this the official website? I need to update my address. Can I have a copy of this form? Who is allowed to give legal advice? Which documents should I bring? Where do I sign this form? Can I submit a copy instead of the original? What is the deadline for this application? I made a mistake on this page. Could you explain what this question means? Do I need to make an appointment? How can I check my application status? Can I get a receipt for my application? My name is spelled incorrectly here. Is language assistance available? Vocabulary ID a card or document that shows who you are passport a government book for international travel visa permission to enter or stay for a purpose form a paper or online page you complete deadline the last day to do something copy one more version of a document application a formal request made by completing a form original the first document, rather than a copy signature your name written to show that you agree or confirm something supporting document a document that provides information for an application status the current stage or condition of something official website a website run by the organization it represents US Customs Many official websites end in .gov. Be careful with look-alike websites. Keep digital and paper copies of key documents in safe places. For immigration questions, use official information, your school office, or a qualified lawyer. Use the same name and spelling shown on your identification. Ask staff how to enter a name on a form. If a question on a form is unclear, ask for an explanation before you write or choose an answer. Check the date format and say the month aloud when confirming a deadline. Ask which office handles your question. Keep any confirmation message or reference number after submitting a form. It can help you ask about its progress. Dialogue Student: I moved to a new apartment. Advisor: Did you update your address? Student: Not yet. Where should I do that? Advisor: Use the official government website or your online account. Student: How can I find the correct page? Advisor: Start with the official agency website and look for address changes. Student: Can I ask you if I do not understand the form? Advisor: Yes. I can help you find the instructions or the right office. Student: Thank you. I will check the instructions today. Advisor: You are welcome. Keep any confirmation you receive.

japanese_explanation.heading: 書類は生活の土台
points: アメリカでは、住所、身分証明、署名、期限がとても重要です。書類の写真だけでなく、紙のコピーも安全な場所に保管しましょう。
移民関係の情報は必ず公式サイト、学校の担当者、または資格のある弁護士に確認します。SNSだけを信じないでください。
多くの外国人は引っ越し後にUSCISへ住所変更をする必要があります。郵便局の転送だけではUSCISの住所は変わりません。

existing_simplified_chinese.heading: 文件是美国生活的基础
points: 在美国，地址、身份证明、签名和截止日期都很重要。重要文件要保存电子版，也要把纸质复印件放在安全的地方。
移民信息要查官方网站、学校负责人员，或合格律师。不要只相信社交媒体上的说法。
很多非公民搬家后需要向USCIS更新地址。只做邮局转寄，不会自动更新USCIS地址。

ko.heading: 서류는 생활의 기반입니다
points: 미국에서는 주소, 신분 증명, 서명, 기한이 매우 중요합니다. 서류 사진뿐만 아니라 종이 사본도 안전한 장소에 보관하십시오.
이민 관련 정보는 반드시 공식 웹사이트, 학교 담당자 또는 자격을 갖춘 변호사에게 확인하십시오. SNS 정보만 믿지 마십시오.
많은 외국인은 이사 후 USCIS에 주소 변경을 해야 합니다. 우체국 주소 전송만으로는 USCIS 주소가 변경되지 않습니다.

zh-Hans.heading: 文件是美国生活的基础
points: 在美国，地址、身份证明、签名和截止日期都很重要。重要文件要保存电子版，也要把纸质复印件放在安全的地方。
移民信息要查官方网站、学校负责人员，或合格律师。不要只相信社交媒体上的说法。
很多非公民搬家后需要向USCIS更新地址。只做邮局转寄，不会自动更新USCIS地址。

es.heading: Los documentos son la base de la vida
points: En los Estados Unidos, su dirección, identificación, firma y plazos son muy importantes. Guarde copias en papel y fotos digitales de sus documentos en un lugar seguro.
Confirme la información relacionada con la inmigración siempre con sitios web oficiales, el personal de su escuela o un abogado calificado. No confíe únicamente en las redes sociales.
Muchos no ciudadanos deben actualizar su dirección con USCIS después de mudarse. El reenvío de correo postal solo no cambiará su dirección en USCIS.

pt-BR.heading: Documentos são a base da vida
points: Nos EUA, endereço, comprovante de identidade, assinatura e prazos são muito importantes. Guarde fotos digitais e cópias em papel dos seus documentos em um local seguro.
Sempre confirme informações relacionadas à imigração em sites oficiais, com a equipe da sua escola ou um advogado qualificado. Não confie apenas nas mídias sociais.
Muitos não cidadãos precisam atualizar seu endereço junto ao USCIS após se mudarem. Somente o serviço de redirecionamento dos correios não altera o seu endereço no USCIS.

fr.heading: Les documents sont la base de la vie
points: Aux États-Unis, votre adresse, pièce d'identité, signature et les délais sont très importants. Conservez les copies papier et les photos numériques de vos documents dans un endroit sûr.
Confirmez toujours les informations liées à l'immigration sur les sites web officiels, auprès du personnel de votre école ou d'un avocat qualifié. Ne vous fiez pas uniquement aux médias sociaux.
De nombreux non-citoyens doivent mettre à jour leur adresse auprès de l'USCIS après un déménagement. Le simple réacheminement du courrier par la poste ne modifie pas votre adresse auprès de l'USCIS.

de.heading: Dokumente sind die Grundlage des Lebens
points: In den USA sind Adresse, Identitätsnachweis, Unterschrift und Fristen sehr wichtig. Bewahren Sie sowohl digitale Fotos als auch Papierkopien Ihrer Dokumente an einem sicheren Ort auf.
Bestätigen Sie Informationen zur Einwanderung immer auf offiziellen Websites, bei Ihrem Schulpersonal oder einem qualifizierten Anwalt. Verlassen Sie sich nicht allein auf soziale Medien.
Viele Nicht-Bürger müssen nach einem Umzug ihre Adresse bei USCIS ändern. Eine reine Postumleitung ändert Ihre Adresse bei USCIS nicht.
